comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
`TRROnlyExceptionButtonTelemetry` in `browser_aboutNetError_trr.js` polled for telemetry events using `Services.telemetry.snapshotEvents(DATASET, true)` inside a `waitForCondition` loop. The `true` parameter **clears all accumulated events on every poll iteration**. Since the events are recorded in the content process via `RPMRecordGleanEvent` and must transit IPC to reach the parent-process telemetry store, they may not have arrived yet when the poll fires — and get wiped. This created a race window as large as the 2-second IPC batch timeout (`toolkit.telemetry.ipcBatchTimeout`).

The failure signature was `TypeError: can't access property "shift", firstEvent is undefined` — the event was cleared before `.find()` could match it, so the returned value was `undefined` and the subsequent `.shift()` call threw.

### Why It Spiked in April 2026

Bug 2027860 removed a 3×100ms `setTimeout` loop (`retryErrorCode`) from `aboutNetError.mjs` that had been delaying error-page initialization for non-cert-error pages. The fix made the error page initialize faster, changing the timing of telemetry recording relative to the IPC flush cycle and making the race more likely to trigger.

Bug 1831977 - Fix intermittent browser_aboutNetError_trr.js by migrating DoH telemetry tests to Glean APIs r=valentin,#necko-reviewers,#intermittent-reviewers


The TRROnlyExceptionButtonTelemetry test was using snapshotEvents(..., true)
inside a waitForCondition loop, which cleared content-process events on every
poll before they could arrive via IPC, causing a persistent race condition.

Move shared TRR setup helpers (DNS override, loadTRRErrorPage, resetTRRPrefs)
to head.js. Migrate the DoH telemetry assertions into the renamed
browser_aboutNetError_telemetry.js using Services.fog.testFlushAllChildren()
and Glean.securityDohNeterror.*.testGetValue(), following the pattern already
established in that file. Remove the flaky task from browser_aboutNetError_trr.js
and drop the Bug 1831977 skip-if entries from browser.toml.
